dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear largely smooth with no clear structural bulges or indentations identifiable through the surface water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to bluish-grey median pixel intensity; significantly lighter than a slate-grey neonate/juvenile baseline but lacking the high-reflectance white of a fully mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency dark-pixel clusters and faint linear streaks are distributed across the dorsal plane, particularly visible on the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient slopes between the light-grey baseline and darker textural mottling are diffuse with low edge-contrast.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, linear high-contrast markings (rake marks) distributed across the mid and posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple fine, longitudinal linear scratches (rake marks) are visible across the dorsal surface.
